description: Container releases of this project, per environment, with health checks and rollback.

reasons.health_check_failed: The new release didn't pass its health check.
reasons.host_key_untrusted: The host key isn't trusted: run Test connection on the target and trust it.
reasons.interrupted: OpsHub restarted during the deployment; check the target.
reasons.strategy_not_supported: The target doesn't support this strategy.

targets.title: Deploy targets
targets.description: Servers and clusters OpsHub deploys container images to. Pipelines refer to them by name.
targets.emptyManage: Add an SSH host, Docker host or Kubernetes cluster to deploy to.
targets.deleteBody: Pipelines that deploy to it will fail. The release history keeps its name.
targets.created: Deploy target added. Run Test connection next.

form.intro: Secrets are encrypted and can't be read back.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dashes. Pipelines use it as deploy.target.
form.hostsHint: One per line: host or host:port (default port 22).
form.batchSizeHint: Rolling: how many hosts are updated together.
form.commandHint: Runs on each host with $OPSHUB_VERSION (the image) and $OPSHUB_PREVIOUS_VERSION set. It must exit 0.
form.portsHint: One per line: host:container, e.g. 80:8080. One replica only.
form.k8sContainerHint: Leave empty for the first container.
form.serviceHint: Needed for blue/green: its selector switches between colors.
form.healthUrlHint: Optional. Must answer 2xx after each update; {host} is each host's name.
form.credentialsHint: Write-only: stored encrypted, used only by deployments.
form.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored value.
form.kubeconfigHint: With a service account token or embedded client certificate; exec plugins aren't supported.

test.title: Test connection: {{name}}
test.description: OpsHub connects to the target and checks what it will deploy to.
test.trustHint: Check the fingerprint with the server's administrator before trusting it. Credentials are only sent to trusted hosts.
test.failedHint: Fix the target's settings or credentials, then test again.

deploy.title: Deploy a release
deploy.description: Puts a container image on a target for an environment. A failed health check puts the previous release back.
deploy.noTargets: No deploy targets: an organization admin adds them.
deploy.versionHint: The full image reference, with a tag or digest.

history.title: History
history.emptyHint: Deploy an image with the Deploy button, or from a pipeline job with a deploy block.

detail.title: Deployment #{{number}}
detail.revertedNote: The previous release was put back.

rollback.title: Roll back {{environment}}?
rollback.body: {{current}} is replaced by the previous release, {{previous}}.
